fields.summary_ko.0: TSMC (NYSE:TSM) recorded October revenue of NT$58.689 billion (approximately $18.4 billion), an all-time high, up 14.7% month-over-month and 59.7% year-over-year.
fields.summary_ko.1: Wedbush Securities assessed that TSMC is outpacing seasonal patterns, suggesting sustained demand for advanced chips destined for AI data centers.
